_doc: Human verdicts on ditto marks the gate gave up: the missing half of results/ditto_review_*.
PIPELINE.md #1 asks for the verdict to be recorded per volume, and nothing ever did. The queue
is derived (ia_volume_to_jsonl.ditto_lead_candidates); the verdict is not.
`confirmed` marks go to the sweep as `confirmed_marks`: they skip the share floor (and the 5%
digit floor) but not the name-follower ratio, which is a property of the data. survey_harvest.py
--rederive applies them; the harvest records them as `harvest.filtered.ditto_confirmed`.
`rejected` keeps the reason, so a regenerated queue can be read against it.
Each verdict was made on the page images: data_prep/ditto_review_page.py --id <volume>.

rejected.&: not a ditto (hadro): mostly a business name or address wrapped onto a second line, or a ditto mark followed by an ampersand whose ditto the OCR dropped
rejected.4: the same case: 9 of 10 crops are a printed '" &' with the & read as 4 and the ditto dropped, the 10th a wrapped '& Liquor Co'. Admitting it would turn 'Gluck & Mandel' into 'Gluck Mandel'

trowsgeneraldire1915trow.note: The 14 confirmed marks are OCR readings of the printed '"', the 1915 ditto, which shatters across OCR variants (PIPELINE.md #18). They start 33,477 scoped lines.
